⚠️TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Channel-Port aux Basques RCMP is currently responding to a tractor trailer blocking the westbound lane of the Trans-Canada Highway between Red Rocks and St. Andrew’s.

While the TCH is passable, motorists should expect delays and are asked to drive with extreme caution and patience. Slow down and obey all instructions from first responders. A reminder that the Move Over Law requires that you slow down for emergency vehicles.

Police are reporting icy road conditions and limited visibility due to snow. Increasing winds are also impacting travel conditions. Please consider delaying any immediate travel. If you must travel, please exercise caution and patience and drive according to road and weather conditions.

Remember — snow means slow!
